name: 04210 · Auburn, ME
findings: ZIP 04210 (Auburn) has 111 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 04210 (Auburn) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 04210 (Auburn) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.
